rationale: Setting --salmon_quant_libtype A makes the shared SALMON_QUANT selector for QUANTIFY_BAM_SALMON and QUANTIFY_PSEUDO_ALIGNMENT pass --libType=A, so Salmon auto-detects the library type instead of using the samplesheet strandedness. The strandedness-inference SALMON_QUANT under FASTQ_SUBSAMPLE_FQ_SALMON uses its own selector (--skipQuant) and is unchanged. The changed quantifications propagate to tximport/tx2gene, the SummarizedExperiment objects, both DESeq2 QC runs and MultiQC, while alignment, RSeQC, bigWig and StringTie, which rely on meta.strandedness, are untouched.
